outbound.summary: Refine Retina/QNDRF into target-calibrated active sensing with explicit global coverage debt plus a versioned owned visual-evidence descriptor cache. ROI confidence alone is insufficient; no cache may preserve raw unowned libmtmd pointers or cross version mismatches.

Current GUI uncertainty evidence indicates UQ rankings/calibration do not reliably transfer across model classes/interfaces. Any PBC threshold must therefore be calibrated and revalidated on the exact target model/runtime/interface and attacked with wrong-confidence/interface-shift controls.

knowledge_needs.question: On the exact accepted llama.cpp target build, does native multimodal/KV/prompt caching persist a version-safe media representation across requests without a second vision encode, or only token/KV state?
knowledge_needs.reason: If native runtime already supplies exact safe cross-request media-feature reuse, Frank-owned VEC may be redundant; if not, VEC remains a discriminating candidate.
